Name: OWASP ZAP
OneLiner: Free web application security scanner and proxy.
BestFor: Finding common web vulnerabilities in staging
NotIdealFor: Replacing a manual review or a pentest

Name: Burp Suite
OneLiner: The standard toolkit for manual web security testing.
TokenTips: Learn with the free PortSwigger Web Security Academy

Name: Trivy
OneLiner: Scans container images, filesystems and infrastructure code for vulnerabilities and misconfigurations.
BestFor: CI checks on images and dependencies
TokenTips: Fail builds only on fixable high severity at first
Re-scan regularly: new CVEs appear daily

Name: Dependabot
OneLiner: Opens pull requests to update vulnerable or outdated dependencies.
TokenTips: Have tests that make merging safe

Name: Have I Been Pwned
OneLiner: Checks whether an email or password has appeared in known data breaches.
TokenTips: Use the k-anonymity password API so passwords never leave your server in full

Name: Semgrep
OneLiner: Fast, rule-based code scanning for bugs and security issues.
BestFor: Catching known bad patterns in pull requests
TokenTips: Write a custom rule for your own recurring mistake
